description.value: Pat Duke Memorial Arena is Lumby's community ice facility, hosting ice hockey, lacrosse, and public skating for residents of the North Okanagan. Operated by the Regional District of North Okanagan, it serves as a central community gathering point in this small Interior BC town. Touring cyclists passing through Lumby may find it a convenient landmark, though it is primarily a local sports venue rather than a cycling-specific destination.
